name: Dawnstar of Shahar
desc: A glorious, illusory weapon that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. It is said that, in an ancient age beyond all recollection, the first divine envoy bestowed her sacred sigil upon the high priest of Hyperborea, granting them the right to lead the resplendent city of gold.
